evidence: The register contract accepts two firing-path forms; the gate's own diagnostic text in scripts/impact-chain-gate.rb names `firing-path: command:<changed repo executable>` beside the `file:<changed markdown>#<anchor>` form, and register_firing_path_resolution_ok resolved the command locator on every checker run of this round (444 locators). The finding rests on the review plan's acceptance sentence, which describes the file-anchor form only; the plan is untrusted input and the contract is the primary source. The test executable named by the locator is itself the mechanical firing path for the row's obligation.
